messages.body_plain:

There’s some information on multiple dlls in this issue discussion https://github.com/kaskr/adcomp/issues/43 beginning 2 Apr 2016.

cheers,
Mollie

> On 1May 2019, at 2:47, sarah....@gmail.com wrote:
>
> Hi all!
>
> I was wondering if anyone had any possible insights as to what is causing my package to fail installation on Linux machines.
>
> The package can be installed using `devtools::install_github("sarahromanes/genDA")`.
>
> It seems to install fine on Windows and OSX, but the issue I have discovered when building on Travis/ my school servers is that the R installation complains about multiple definitions of TMB objects (eg .... ` multiple definition of `MakeADGradObject`). See attached example of error message
>
> My setup is slightly unusual in that I am linking to more than one dll - I used this blog a a work around (https://rtbecard.gitlab.io/2018/02/11/Distributing-TMB-in-R-packages.html) - not sure if this is causing the issue at all.
>
> I'm not savvy at all with how Linux machines work or what they expect different compared to my usual windows setup (I know the dll/so is different that is all).
>
> Any help would be much appreciated! Sorry If this has been answered before
>
> Cheers
> Sarah
>

messages.subject: False convergence warning
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

I’m trying to use glmmTMB to get a model with crossed random effects and an unstructured covariance matrix for the residuals to run. Please note that I was able to get this model to run in SPSS without problems. However, I wanted to use R for its ease of checking multilevel modeling assumptions.

Here is the syntax for the model I tried to run in glmmTMB:

glmmTMB(AATTRACT ~ 1 + Agender+ (0 + MF + FM|GROUPID:MaleID) +

                   (0 + FM + MF|GROUPID:FemaleID)  + us(MF + FM + 0| GROUPID:MaleID:FemaleID),

                    data = SD_data,  family = gaussian(link = "identity"), dispformula=~0, REML = FALSE,

                   verbose = TRUE)

I received the following error message after running this model:

Warning message:

In fitTMB(TMBStruc) : Model convergence problem; false convergence (8). See vignette('troubleshooting')

I also received the following mgc after running verbose = TRUE (I’m only including the last few lines):

iter: 1  value: -5887.346 mgc: 0.003152465 ustep: 1

iter: 2  value: -5887.346 mgc: 5.733777e-08 ustep: 1

mgc: 7.849359e-08

outer mgc:  0.2594169

Does anyone have any insights into what might be going wrong?

Thanks!

Rob

messages.subject: CDF of t-distribution
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I trying to experiment with the skew t-distribution and by looking at the implementation from the sn package, its density has the following form:

pdf(x) = dt(x) * 2 * pt(x), where pt is the cdf of the t-distribution. I can't see to find this function in TMB, so I'm wondering if anyone here has any tips on how to implement this in a good way?

Thanks in advance!

Jens
